common.soonText: The page will be fully functional once the backend API is ready.
common.urlOnlyHint: File upload isn’t available yet — paste a link instead.

auth.title: Welcome back!
auth.subtitle: Enter your phone number. No password needed — sign-in is confirmed through your device.
auth.deviceNote: This browser will be added to your devices as “{{device}}”.

errors.notFound: No user with this number. Check the number or contact your center admin.
errors.blocked: Your account is blocked. Please contact Acadium support.

pending.title: Approve this sign-in
pending.text: A sign-in request from a new device was sent for {{phone}}. For security it must be approved from a device you already trust.
pending.step1: Open the Acadium app on your phone
pending.step3: Tap “Approve”, then press “I approved — sign in” here
pending.hint: Each attempt creates a new request, so approve on your phone first, then press the button.
pending.still: Not approved yet. Approve the latest request on your phone and try again.

mobileOnly.title: Please use the mobile app
mobileOnly.text: The web panel is for center admins and teachers. As a {{role}}, sign in with the Acadium mobile app — attendance, homework and grades are all there.

errors.network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.timeout: The server didn’t respond. Try again shortly.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have permission for this action.

validation.phone: Enter the full number: +998 XX XXX XX XX
validation.timeOrder: End time must be after start time

payments.soon: Payments and debt tracking are in development.

students.search: Search by name, phone or group…
students.addHint: The student signs in to the Acadium mobile app with this number.
students.groupHint: You can assign a group later.
students.emptyHint: Add your first student — they can sign in to the app right away.
students.phoneLocked: The phone can’t be changed — it’s used to sign in.
students.noGradesHint: Grades appear here once a teacher adds them.
students.noAttendanceHint: Records appear when the student checks in at the center via the app.
students.noParentsHint: Add a parent under “Parents” and pick this child.

teachers.addHint: The teacher signs in to the web panel with this number to manage homework and grades.
teachers.emptyHint: Add a teacher to run groups, homework and grades.
teachers.noGroupsHint: Assigning teachers to groups is coming soon.

parents.addHint: Parents follow their child’s attendance, homework and grades in the app.
parents.emptyHint: Add a parent and link their children.

groups.formHint: Lesson days and time appear in the schedule.
groups.onlineHint: Zoom, Google Meet or Jitsi link — students join from the app.
groups.teacherSoon: The API for assigning a teacher to a group isn’t ready yet.
groups.emptyHint: Create your first group: name, lesson days and time.
groups.emptyTeacher: You don’t have any groups yet.
groups.addExistingHint: The selected student will be moved to “{{name}}”.
groups.noStudentsHint: Add a new student or move an existing one here.
groups.deleteText: The group and its schedule will be deleted; students stay without a group. This can’t be undone.

homework.created: Homework created. Students and parents were notified.

devices.pendingHint: Requests to sign in from new devices. Approve only devices you recognise.
devices.trustedHint: Devices that can access your account. Remove any you don’t recognise.
devices.revokeText: “{{name}}” will no longer be able to sign in and will need approval again.
